clang-libstdcxx.conf.rationale: Clang and LLVM tools with the active GCC libstdc++ ABI for packages that cannot use libc++.

gcc.conf.rationale: Preserves the established GCC frontend and GCC binutils lane while making its inherited clang preprocessor and lld linker explicit.

highway-noavx512.conf.rationale: Preserves the tested GCC frontend and LLVM support-tool tuple used by Highway and libjxl while AVX512 is disabled.

libstdcxx-headers.conf.rationale: Clang and LLVM tools use driver discovery of the active GCC libstdc++ installation without a stale GCC-major path.

opensp-clang-cxx.conf.rationale: OpenSP requires the reviewed Clang C++ driver and explicit libstdc++ link correction for its legacy libtool link rules.

rust-llvm21.conf.rationale: Records the already-tested mixed Rust bootstrap lane exactly instead of incorrectly claiming that every support tool is LLVM 21.

dev-java/openjdk.rationale: The sandbox and ccache FEATURES exception is independent of the no-Polly compiler tier.

dev-util/cargo-c.rationale: The first profile supplies non-LTO Rust flags; the later profile intentionally supplies no-Polly C-family flags.

dev-util/spirv-tools.rationale: The O2 compiler tier is followed by the reviewed public-ABI visibility lane, which retains established SPIR-V Tools exports while disabling forced libraries.

media-libs/libjxl.rationale: The Highway AVX512 restriction, visibility/ABI preservation, GCC frontend tuple, and live-source selection are independent reviewed controls for libjxl.

media-sound/ncspot.rationale: Rust retains the ThinLTO profile, C-family helpers use no-Polly flags, and the terminal workaround is an independent variable.

net-libs/webkit-gtk.rationale: The O2 compiler tier is followed by the reviewed WebKit public-ABI visibility lane for JavaScriptCore and WTF DSOs.

sys-apps/hwloc.rationale: The O2 compiler tier and the package-specific ROCm configure argument affect independent variables.

sys-apps/lact.rationale: The first profile supplies non-LTO Rust flags; the later profile intentionally supplies no-Polly C-family flags.

sys-devel/gcc.rationale: The reviewed GCC compiler lane and ccache FEATURES removal affect independent settings.

sys-fs/zfs.rationale: The kernel-compatible GCC lane is independent of the explicitly local-only package bashrc hook.

x11-base/xorg-server.rationale: The O2 fallback is followed by the append-only libbsd and glibc cdefs compatibility fix.

x11-base/xwayland.rationale: The O3 ABI tier is followed by the append-only libbsd and glibc cdefs compatibility fix.
